title: Coronagraph Watch
text:
🔭 Coronagraph Watch — October 16, 2026

There’s been some elevated solar activity today, so here’s a look at the outer corona.

🔥 Strongest recent flare: C6.0

I'm watching the corona today.

Sunwatch shows two active regions and a prominent elongated coronal hole, while the coronagraph remains CME-quiet in this frame.

Image: NOAA SWPC — CCOR-2
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
